name: House Mercere
description: Hermetic House composed mostly of unGifted Redcaps who serve as couriers, bankers and guardians for the Order; the Gift is rarer here than in any other House.

name: Redcap
description: UnGifted members of House Mercere who carry messages between covenants, trade vis and hold all the rights of magi.

name: Mercere
description: Founder of House Mercere who visited every domus magna, established Harco, took only his own Gifted children as apprentices and later lost his Gift.

name: Societas Merceris
description: Societies within House Mercere, each with its own history, outlook and joining requirements.

name: Mercer House
description: A support covenant, or part of a covenant, that serves as the Redcaps' administrative centre and treasury for a Tribunal, run by a senior Redcap.

name: Senior Redcap
description: The Redcap who runs a Mercer House, keeps track of local Redcaps and represents the House at Tribunal.

name: Iberian Tribunal
description: Tribunal in which the Barcelona Mercer House, known as Yuval's, is located.

name: Yuval's
description: Informal name of the Mercer House in Barcelona, named after its senior Redcap and reputed as a wealthy, slightly sinister house of magic and vice.

name: Yuval
description: Senior Redcap of the Mercer House in Barcelona, which is named after him.

name: Barcelona
description: City in the Iberian Tribunal where the Mercer House known as Yuval's stands.

name: Rhine Tribunal
description: Tribunal where two Mercer Houses compete for dominance.

name: Tribunal
description: Regional gathering of magi; House Mercere must distribute invitations about a year in advance and swear to having done so before it begins.

name: Praeco
description: Official who decides when and where Tribunal meets and whose expenses are reimbursed from the Tribunal treasury.

name: Presiding Quaesitor
description: Quaesitor who presides at Tribunal, to whom the senior Redcap swears the invitation duty was fulfilled.

name: Quaesitor
description: Hermetic investigators and judges; their presence or a letter from them is needed for Redcaps to make binding vis contracts.

name: Domus Magna
description: The chief covenant of a House; Mercere visited every domus magna at least once every seven years.

name: Covenant Registration
description: Mercere tradition whereby covenants register their address with the House to be visited by Redcaps, agreeing to shelter any member of the Order for three days a year.

name: Vis Source Registration
description: Practice of recording a vis source's location and yield with the Redcaps so they can swear to prior ownership at Tribunal.

name: Harco
description: Domus magna of House Mercere established by Mercere, where messages for other Tribunals are collected via Mercere's Portals.

name: Mercere's Portal
description: Paired enchanted archways connecting distant locations, whose construction secret is restricted to House Mercere; guarded by custodians who collect tolls.

name: Blacklisting
description: Informal House Mercere sanction in which Redcaps refuse to recognize a covenant or magus, losing records and messages.

name: Hibernian Tribunal
description: Tribunal where the story is told of a Flambeau wizard blacklisted by Redcaps after burning one alive.

name: House Flambeau
description: Hermetic House; a tenth-century Flambeau declared Wizard's War on a Redcap, and Flambeau magi helped rebuild the Cult of Mercury.

name: Wizard's War
description: Formal declaration of hostilities between members of the Order of Hermes.

name: Stonehenge
description: Place where a Redcap fled to hide during a Wizard's War before being burned alive.

name: Hibernia
description: Ireland, home of the blacklisted Flambeau wizard.

name: Vis
description: Raw magical power in physical form, prized as payment, traded, lent and banked by Redcaps.

name: Vis Exchange
description: Redcap practice of trading vis like moneychangers, usually two units for one.

name: Pawn
description: Unit of vis (pigni, 'p'); ten pawns make a rook and ten rooks a queen, a system popularized by Venafro.

name: Vis Tenta
description: Vis associated with a Technique ('persistent vis'), valued at twice vis forma.

name: Vis Forma
description: Vis associated with a Form ('formed vis').

name: Muto
description: Hermetic Technique of transformation; Mercere had a natural affinity for it, inherited by the Mutantes.

name: Corpus
description: Hermetic Form of the human body.

name: Aquam
description: Hermetic Form of water.

name: Ignem
description: Hermetic Form of fire.

name: Intellego
description: Hermetic Technique of perception.

name: Creo
description: Hermetic Technique of creation, highly valued by Mercere for healing and longevity potions.

name: Vim
description: Hermetic Form of magic itself.

name: Rego
description: Hermetic Technique of control.

name: Animal
description: Hermetic Form of animals; Mutantes sympathize with those who study it.

name: Terram
description: Hermetic Form of earth, used as a requisite for Twinning the Tome and in Mercere's Portals.

name: Usury
description: The Church's moral crime of charging interest on loans, which Redcaps avoid the appearance of when lending vis.

name: Lien
description: Loan in which the lender receives the use of a borrower's vis source until repaid.

name: Pawning (Magic Items)
description: Redcap practice of lending about half an item's value in vis against a magic device that can be bought back within a set time.

name: Speculation
description: Mercer House funding of risky expeditions in search of vis sources in return for a share of profit.

name: Usurer
description: Character option representing a professional lender who charges high interest (see Appendix, Virtues and Flaws).

name: Outsider
description: Flaw that Jewish characters should take.

name: Enemies
description: Flaw European usurers might take to represent consequences of opposing the Church.

name: Profession: Accountant
description: Ability usurer characters should start with.

name: Stonehenge Tribunal
description: Tribunal that in 1208 limited magically created silver to two pounds per resident per year.

name: Peripheral Code
description: Body of Hermetic legal precedent and Tribunal rulings supplementing the Code.

name: Grand Tribunal
description: Order-wide Tribunal; site of a famous two-day certamen in the form of a chess game.

name: Magical Silver
description: Magically created silver, which Redcaps refuse and which the Stonehenge Tribunal limited after it caused inflation.

name: Hermetic Charity
description: Tradition of Redcaps secretly leaving gifts of vis to deserving magi at the start of winter.

name: Longevity Ritual
description: Magic that slows aging; Mercer Houses commission longevity potions for Redcaps from magi.

name: Notary
description: Redcap holding a Quaesitor's letter authorizing binding vis contracts; their notes are treated as legal tender at Mercer Houses.

name: Tribunal Treasury
description: Tribunal funds controlled by a Mercer House, which reimburses Tribunal expenses and collects fines.

name: Schism War
description: Conflict after which the Diedne were destroyed; since then Mercere has been a House devoted to peace and Portals use passwords.

name: Venafro
description: Italian Redcap who harvested vis in lands left by the Diedne into chess-pawn tokens, giving rise to the 'pawn' unit.

name: House Diedne
description: House whose passing left wild lands in Ireland and Britain empty for Venafro to seek vis.

name: House Tremere
description: Hermetic House whose magi especially embraced Venafro's vis pawns.

name: Certamen
description: Formal magical duel; a famous certamen at Grand Tribunal took the form of a chess game; Redcaps cannot fight it.

name: The Pawnbrokers
description: Societas Merceris of Redcaps who harvest vis into custom shapes such as tokens, coins, jewelry or tattoos, named in memory of Venafro.

name: Personal Vis Source
description: Hermetic Virtue Pawnbroker Redcaps may take to represent vis they discovered in the wild.

name: Craft
description: Ability Pawnbroker Redcaps should have at least one of.

name: Custodian
description: Custodial Redcap who escorts others through danger, guards Portals, collects fines and debts, and hunts bounties.

name: Bounty
description: Reward in vis offered by a senior Redcap for dealing with a threat to travel.

name: Hoplite
description: Magi who hunt down those cast out of the Order.

name: Transylvanian Tribunal
description: Tribunal where in 1151 Dorisa charged Constantine of Mercere with taking vis from her sanctum.

name: Dorisa
description: Maga of Ex Miscellanea who charged Redcap Constantine with taking twelve pawns of vis from her sanctum.

name: House Ex Miscellanea
description: Hermetic House to which Dorisa belongs.

name: Constantine of Mercere
description: Redcap who entered Dorisa's sanctum to collect a debt of twelve pawns; the charges were dismissed.

name: Sanctum
description: A magus's private laboratory domain.

name: Thebes Tribunal
description: Tribunal where in 1179 Bartholomew of Mercere was tried for seizing a staff from Errantus.

name: Bartholomew of Mercere
description: Redcap acquitted of stealing a staff from Errantus but fined for injuring him.

name: Errantus
description: Criamon magus who kept a staff stolen from Justina and was injured by Bartholomew.

name: Justina of Criamon
description: Filia of Errantus whose staff he stole; awarded twelve pawns in damages.

name: House Criamon
description: Hermetic House of Errantus and Justina.

name: The Bloodcaps
description: Societas Merceris lineage descended from a Mercere adoptee's daughter and a violent border faerie; they dye their caps in blood.

name: Bloodcap Faerie
description: Wicked, violent faeries of battlefields and ruined towers with long teeth and talons who dye their caps in their foes' blood.

name: Faerie Blood
description: Minor General Virtue; the Bloodcap variety gives +1 Strength, long teeth and nails and susceptibility to the Divine.

name: Greater Malediction
description: Flaw Bloodcaps may take: the cross or scripture causes their teeth and nails to fall out.

name: Lesser Malediction
description: Flaw Bloodcaps may take: the cross and scripture cause them pain.

name: The Leap of Homecoming
description: ReCo35 spell enchanted into the iron shoes many Bloodcaps wear.

name: Divine
description: Realm of Power to which Bloodcaps are very susceptible.

name: British Isles
description: Region where Bloodcap legends lead most Redcaps to forgo their caps.

name: Legacy
description: Flaw required for Followers of Belin; also qualifies characters for Heroic Virtues and Flaws.

name: Belin
description: Mercere's last apprentice, a legendary female Redcap famed for loyalty, clever disguises and escaping a siege by feigning death.

name: Followers of Belin
description: Societas Merceris of Belin's descendants and adoptees who serve as elite, humble messengers.

name: Wandering Redcap
description: Redcaps who serve reluctantly and travel widely, discovering vis sources and trading news.

name: Lone Redcap
description: Minor Status Virtue for a Redcap without ties to a Mercer House, forgoing its magic items and longevity potions.

name: Orbus
description: Sanction declaring a Redcap an orphan and throwing him out of House Mercere.

name: Mercere Primus
description: Head of House Mercere, who issues warnings to Redcaps flouting their duties.

name: The Gift
description: Innate ability to work Hermetic magic; extremely rare in House Mercere.

name: Golias
description: Tenth-century Redcap poet, patron of Fudarus, cast out for diabolism; revered as 'Bishop Golias' by the Goliards.

name: Fudarus
description: Domus magna of House Tytalus, where Golias was a semi-permanent resident.

name: House Tytalus
description: Hermetic House whose corruption (diabolism) came to light just before the end of the millennium.

name: The Goliards
description: Societas Merceris of artistic magi and Redcaps celebrating life's pleasures through song and parody.

name: Carmina Burana
description: Famous work produced by the Goliards.

name: Credo au Ribaut
description: Goliard poem quoted as the Goliard Credo.

name: University of Paris
description: Institution where Goliards seek apprentices.

name: Clerk
description: Virtue Goliards may take for their academic background.

name: Educated
description: Virtue Goliards may take for their academic background.

name: Compulsion
description: Flaw Goliards must take for an inspirational vice.

name: Free Expression
description: Virtue many Goliards possess.

name: Inspirational
description: Virtue many Goliards possess.

name: Hermetic Patron
description: Virtue representing a magus patron; common for Goliards and Milvi Redcaps.

name: Illegitimate Lineage
description: Applies to Mercere magi who cannot trace ancestry to the Founder.

name: Bonisagus
description: Founder to whom Mercere presented potential students; author of Bonisagus's Theory.

name: Trianoma
description: Founder who approached Mercere and received his non-family students.

name: Deleterious Circumstances
description: Hermetic Flaw (in public) appropriate for Mercere magi who feel guilty about magic.

name: Necessary Condition
description: Hermetic Flaw (casting tools) appropriate for Mercere magi.

name: Puissant Art
description: Starting Mercere magi take Puissant Art (Creo) or (Muto) as their free Virtue.

name: Priamitus
description: Mercere's first apprentice and son, who became a priest of the Cult of Mercury and taught Mercurian magic as a Hermetic lineage.

name: Cult of Mercury
description: Pagan cult preserving Roman worship of natural powers, practicing Mercurian rituals; rebuilt by Priamitus with Flambeau help.

name: Mercury
description: Roman god; Mercurian magi describe Mercere as Mercury reborn.

name: Mercurian Magi
description: Mercere magi of Priamitus's lineage who practice Mercurian magic and spell mastery abilities.

name: Mercurian Magic
description: Virtue Hero-Cult magi may take; Mercurian rituals cost less vis.

name: Magic Realm
description: Realm through which Mercurians believe they ascend to join Mercere.

name: Magic Theory
description: Hermetic theory into which Mercurian ceremonies were integrated.

name: Spell Mastery
description: Mastered spell abilities; Mercurian and Mutantes lineages have special mastery abilities.

name: Adaptive Casting
description: Cult of Mercury mastery ability letting mastery apply to similar spells.

name: Ceremonial Casting
description: Cult of Mercury mastery ability adding Artes Liberales and Philosophiae when casting ceremonially.

name: Disguised Casting
description: Cult of Mercury mastery ability to suppress or alter one's sigil.

name: Lab Mastery
description: Cult of Mercury mastery ability adding mastery to Lab Totals for similar effects.

name: Learn from Mistakes
description: Cult of Mercury mastery ability gaining experience from botches.

name: Stalwart Casting
description: Cult of Mercury mastery ability reducing fatigue from casting.

name: Boosted Casting
description: Mutantes mastery ability spending vis to increase spell parameters.

name: Harnessed Casting
description: Mutantes mastery ability to end a spell at will.

name: Tethered Casting
description: Mutantes mastery ability passing control of a spell to another person or object.

name: Artes Liberales
description: Ability added in Ceremonial Casting.

name: Philosophiae
description: Ability added in Ceremonial Casting.

name: Sigil
description: Magical signature of a magus, altered by Disguised Casting.

name: Cult of Heroes
description: Societas Merceris seeking reborn heroes of antiquity to adopt as Redcaps and elevate through rituals.

name: Heracles
description: Legendary hero whom the Cult of Heroes believes can be reborn.

name: Arthur
description: Legendary hero whom the Cult of Heroes believes can be reborn.

name: Beowulf
description: Legendary hero whom the Cult of Heroes believes can be reborn.

name: Gilgamesh
description: Legendary hero whom the Cult of Heroes believes can be reborn.

name: Blood of Heroes
description: Special free Virtue making a character a Mythic Companion descended from a hero; allows Heroic Virtues and Flaws.

name: Mythic Companion
description: New character type close in power to magi who can never have The Gift, e.g. those with Blood of Heroes.

name: Pagan
description: Trait most Hero-Cult members have (see Appendix).

name: Mythic Blood
description: Virtue allowing magi to take Heroic Virtues and Flaws.

name: Heroic Virtues and Flaws
description: Category of Virtues and Flaws available only to Heroic characters.

name: Heroic Personality
description: Flaw required for characters with Blood of Heroes.

name: (Physical Characteristic) of the Followers
description: CrCo35 Ritual permanently raising a physical Characteristic by one, to no more than 0.

name: (Physical Characteristic) of the Heroes
description: CrCo60 Ritual permanently raising a physical Characteristic by one up to +5; subject is buried under earth.

name: (Mental Characteristic) of the Followers
description: CrMe35 Ritual raising a mental Characteristic by one, to no more than 0.

name: (Mental Characteristic) of the Heroes
description: CrMe60 Ritual raising a mental Characteristic by one up to +5; subject is immersed in water.

name: Mercury's Blessing
description: CrVi25 Mercurian Ritual giving a Might-like aura that improves chances children will have the Gift or heroic qualities.

name: Durenmar
description: Covenant where Mercere spent much time and Hermes Triceres grew up.

name: Hermes Triceres
description: Mercere's second apprentice and son, nicknamed 'Mutant', who specialized in Muto Vim metamagic.

name: Mutantus
description: Great-grandson of Triceres who studied transformation magic and trained the first Mutantes.

name: Mutantes
description: Mercere lineage descended from Mutantus practicing Mutantum Magic ('magic-taming').

name: Metamagic
description: Muto Vim magic that alters other magic, developed by Triceres.

name: Wizard's Reach
description: Metamagic spell whose rudimentary version was developed by Triceres.

name: Gauntlet
description: Test ending an apprenticeship, which Triceres passed at Tribunal.

name: Mutantum Magic
description: Minor Hermetic Virtue for descendants of the Mutantes allowing Boosted, Harnessed and Tethered spells and items.

name: Magic-Taming
description: Mutantes view of 'taming' wild magic, giving it direction and binding it to service.

name: Boosting
description: Mutantum technique spending vis to increase a spell's Range, Duration, Target or size.

name: Harnessing
description: Mutantum technique letting the caster end a spell early by concentrating.

name: Tethering
description: Mutantum technique passing control of a spell to another or to an object.

name: Boosted Magic
description: Minor Hermetic Virtue allowing vis to boost formulaic spell parameters.

name: Harnessed Magic
description: Minor Hermetic Virtue allowing cancellation of one's spells and items at will; they end when the caster dies.

name: Tethered Magic
description: Minor Hermetic Virtue corresponding to tethering spells.

name: Bound Magic
description: Flaw with the drawbacks of Mutantes powers but none of the benefits.

name: Fettered Magic
description: Flaw with the drawbacks of Mutantes powers but none of the benefits.

name: Tamed Magic
description: Major Hermetic Virtue granting Harnessed and Tethered Magic without drawbacks, usable with spontaneous spells; requires Mutantum Magic.

name: Milvi Antiquiti
description: 'Kites of old', a Societas Merceris of Mutantes and companions who copy and lend ancient books, flying in hawk form.

name: Diodorus Siculus
description: Ancient author of the Bibliotheca Historica describing Egyptian shapechanger priests.

name: Bibliotheca Historica
description: Work by Diodorus Siculus describing Egyptian shapechangers who carried books to Thebes.

name: Great Library at Alexandria
description: Library supposedly maintained by the Mutantes' ancestors before its destruction by Caesar.

name: Caesar
description: Destroyer of the Great Library at Alexandria.

name: Thebes
description: City to which hawk-shapechangers carried books from Alexandria.

name: Latin
description: Language Milvi Redcaps learn to copy books.

name: Profession: Scribe
description: Ability Milvi Redcaps learn to copy books.

name: Twinning the Tome
description: CrAn50 Boosted Ritual creating a near-perfect copy of a book.

name: The Transformed Folio
description: MuAn35 Boosted, Harnessed Ritual changing a book's pages into those of another book.

name: Hunter's Lethal Arrow
description: PeAn40 Tethered spell giving an animal a fatal wound, often tethered to an arrow.

name: Shape of the Ancient Kite
description: MuCo40 harnessed, tethered spell turning the target and carried books into a small raptor.

name: The Tireless Flight
description: ReCo20 boosted, harnessed, tethered spell letting the target ignore fatigue and wound penalties.

name: Sense the True Path
description: InTe15 boosted, tethered spell sensing direction to an arcane connection.

name: Arcane Connection
description: Magical link to a place or thing, used by Sense the True Path and Portals.

name: Animalists
description: Suggested Mercere specialty of magi creating or healing mounts and useful animal materials.

name: Champions
description: Mercere magi who fight certamen on behalf of Redcaps.

name: Healers
description: Mercere magi who craft healing items and spells.

name: Rogues
description: Mercere magi who pose as Redcaps for their own purposes.

name: Vis-Monkeys
description: Disparaging term for magi who devote themselves solely to lab tinkering.

name: Chirurgeon's Healing Touch
description: CrCo20 healing spell practiced by Mercere healers.

name: Purification of the Festering Wounds
description: CrCo20 healing spell practiced by Mercere healers.

name: Demon's Eternal Oblivion
description: Spell used as an example for Adaptive Casting.

name: Hermes' Portal
description: ReTe75 ritual similar to the connecting ceremony for Mercere's Portals.

name: Ritual
description: Ritual spells, which require ceremonial casting and vis.

name: Charmed Life
description: Major Heroic Virtue granting Luck and rerolls of zeros in dangerous circumstances.

name: Luck
description: Virtue included in Charmed Life.

name: Gift of Tongues
description: Minor Heroic Virtue to understand and speak any language when conversing with a fluent speaker.

name: Great Bearer
description: Minor Heroic Virtue letting one carry twice as much and travel twice as far.

name: Heroes' Birthright
description: Minor Heroic Virtue granting a special magical power of up to Level 15.

name: Invisible to Magic
description: Major Heroic Virtue to become temporarily invisible to magic by concentrating.

name: The Wound That Weeps
description: PeCo15 spell used as an example for Invisible to Magic.

name: Weight of a Thousand Hells
description: CrMe25 spell used as an example for Invisible to Magic.

name: Magic Resistance
description: Resistance to spells checked after Invisible to Magic.

name: Well-Traveled
description: Virtue whose benefits Lone Redcaps receive.

name: Poor
description: Flaw forcing a Lone Redcap to work a third season.

name: Wealthy
description: Virtue letting a Lone Redcap work only one season a year.

name: Magic Items
description: Minor General Virtue giving a Redcap 25 more levels of starting magic items.

name: Messenger's Memory
description: Minor Heroic Virtue to recall any short message word for word.

name: Mythic (Characteristic)
description: Minor Heroic Virtue granting a specialty for a positive Characteristic.

name: Mythic Mimicry
description: Major Heroic Virtue to memorize accounts of any length and mimic voices or handwriting.

name: Sure Traveler
description: Minor Heroic Virtue: never lost on known routes and unhindered by travel conditions.

name: Vis Sensitivity
description: Major Heroic Virtue listed among new Virtues.

name: Latent Magic Ability
description: Story circumstance that may warrant Heroic Virtues and Flaws.

name: Order of Hermes
description: The order of magi of which Redcaps are full members.

name: Code of Hermes
description: Hermetic law; spying on Redcaps with magic and stealing vis are Hermetic crimes.

name: Magic Aura
description: Place of magical power where a Gifted Mercere might set up a lab.

name: Mythic Europe
description: The setting of Ars Magica.

name: Grog
description: Mundane servants of a covenant; Mercere's ungifted children often become grogs.

name: Survival
description: Ability boosted by Sure Traveler.

name: Concentration
description: Ability used for concentration rolls, e.g. Invisible to Magic.
